source.title: Retail Sales Index DRSI, Great Britain, nominal unadjusted all-business value indices
source.units: nominal retail sales value index, 2024=100, not seasonally adjusted
source.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Source: Office for National Statistics, DRSI, released 18 September 2026. Filtered/reformatted by FlowCredit; no ONS endorsement.
source.reference_year_evidence: September 2026 release updates reference year from 2023 to 2024=100; no change to growth rates.
source.scope: 19 disjoint retail categories in Great Britain, whole provider/country audit only. Entire ONS dataset excluded from fitting and selection.
source.hierarchy_policy: Frozen CDID19 all-business sector leaves only, excluding Internet-only overlaps, large/small subdivisions, parent totals, commodity indices, percentages and rolling growth series.
source.limitations: National survey aggregates, not independent stores/borrowers. Current-vintage indices and provisional releases; underlying survey periods follow 4/5-week reporting calendars, not exact Gregorian cash receipts. UK omitted from Eurostat countries. No expense/default labels.
source.transformation: Nominal unadjusted sales/turnover VALUE index only; retain published scale, explicit missing nulls and provider flags. No deflated volume, currency conversion, expense/default labels, gap-zero imputation or overlapping industry parents. Negative actual values retained for per-window quality rejection.

protocol.split_algorithm: SHA256('external-country-v1:' + 'eurostat:' + ISOcountry), ascending; first18 train,next6validation,last6audit; ONS GreatBritain audit-only entire provider and country.
protocol.original_plan_access_change: Census MRTS excluded: direct access blocked/API requireskey, FRED terms prohibit ML. Switched wholly unseenprovider audit to ONS before target-label inspection. No Census/FRED data are included.
protocol.ons_units: nominal retail sales value index, 2024=100, not seasonally adjusted
protocol.quality_policy: Reject only affected windows with required missing/nonfinite/negative observations or a break/definition-change flag strictly inside the window. Retain other windows from the series. Estimated/provisional actual releases retained; forecast/imputed/low-reliability/confidential values become explicit null.
